rules.coordinates: OperationalPlan/action JSON tile is [row,col]. Runtime tile is (x=col,y=row), converted as (col,row).
rules.damage: Current formula layer: physical max(0.05A,A-D); arts max(0.05A,0.01A*(100-RES)); attack interval T0/(clamp(S,10,600)/100).
rules.economy: Natural DP and provided ledger deltas are model calculations. Refunds, skill DP and merchant upkeep are only valid with their stated evidence and conditions.
rules.range_orientation: GameData range offsets are stored for RIGHT. ApproximateRealRangeTransformer rotates them in bottom-left field coordinates.
rules.simulator_win: Current Simulator wins when no enemy leaks, the spawn schedule is exhausted, and no active enemies remain.
rules.time_sp_recovery: Current public low-rarity runtime advances time-SP by 1.0 SP/s only while inactive. SP is paused while a skill is active.
rules.unknown: Exact client timing, active roadblock ordinary-WALK navigation, target priority and unsupported effects remain UNKNOWN unless supplied evidence says otherwise.

corrected_mechanism_support.artillery_candidate_timeline: Cast starts cooldown and selection; with no slowdown, OnAttack creates the fixed-point projectile about cast+0.333333 seconds, and the hit is about creation+3.0 seconds. This is 2.7.81 candidate evidence, not build-2771 equality.
corrected_mechanism_support.disappear_appear: enemy is hidden between source DISAPPEAR and APPEAR_AT_POS; exact client visibility and target rules remain UNKNOWN
corrected_mechanism_support.fragment_or_wave_wait: checkpoint time is used as the wait duration in the current model
corrected_mechanism_support.medical_candidate_scope: The confirmed ratio filter selects the lowest missing-HP-ratio in range and excludes full HP; exact equal-ratio tie-break remains UNKNOWN.
corrected_mechanism_support.neutral_faction_and_ordinary_blocking: Ursus Civilian is neutral; ordinary operators neither attack nor block it
corrected_mechanism_support.officer_protected_target_attack_radius: enemy_1107_uoffcr can normally attack Ursus Civilian within 1.2
corrected_mechanism_support.protected_target_candidate_scope: Neutral-promotion before hatred sorting is confirmed for the 2.7.81 selector; exact hatred values and all tie-breaks remain UNKNOWN.
corrected_mechanism_support.protected_target_life_scoring: safe arrival neither leaks nor deducts life; death deducts 1 and is not a kill
corrected_mechanism_support.roadblock_special_blocking: PRTS-backed 0.4472 roadblock radius blocks Ursus Civilian and release occurs on destruction; it is not ordinary operator blocking
corrected_mechanism_support.stage_move_multiplier: applied once to enemy raw move speed
unknowns: other protected-target families and exact continuous-frame client timing
corrected_mechanism_support.win_rule: remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies

m58_execution_capability_contract.ansel_talent: The probabilistic extra-heal talent is unsupported; do not assume double healing.
m58_execution_capability_contract.artillery_ability: Ability cast starts target selection and cooldown; projectile birth locks the impact point and has its own delayed splash flow.
m58_execution_capability_contract.ordinary_attack: Current model selects the target at ATTACK_STRIKE; it has no reliable pre-swing target lock. A completed attack's cooldown is not reset by changing target.
m58_execution_capability_contract.spot_skill: EXECUTABLE_APPROXIMATED: initial SP25/SP40, 25 seconds, ATK+45%, 1.3-second healing interval, x-4 nine-cell range, and healing stops attacks; the physical-dodge talent is unsupported.
m58_execution_capability_contract.usage: These are current executor limits, not arguments against user experience. Separate current-model-checkable baiting from USER_PREMISE_NOT_EXPRESSIBLE pre-swing timing.

milestone_constraints.counting_rule: The union of selected_low_star_operator_ids and every DEPLOY action operator_id is counted; retreat and redeploy do not reduce distinct-operator count.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward maintains artillery contact through its eastern vertical cycles. Ansel sustains him. Source death does not remove born projectiles.
Midnight clears restraint3 during his first arts window. The upper civilian must leave eastern artillery acquisition before repeated lethal hits; Steward later clears restraint1.
Melantha clears restraint4 between fights before the civilian's arrival. Melantha later clears restraint2.
Fang supplies actual upper-central blocking. Midnight and Steward's approach damage must clear an occupant before the second late runner would exceed two slots.
Friston supplies actual lower-central blocking. Hibiscus preserves him while Midnight and approaching-enemy damage reduce the backlog.
Midnight blocks and kills upper-outer enemies under Ansel; his blocked enemies can interrupt central damage.
Melantha blocks and kills lower-outer enemies under Hibiscus. Her one-block lane requires sequential clearance, including the ten-second officer pair.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central two-block interception; available assistance to Friston; living automatic income.
Upper-outer interception, both central holders' available damage, eastern upper restraint clearance.
Lower-outer interception and eastern lower restraint clearance.
Heal Fang, Midnight, Steward and himself in ordinary range.
Eastern artillery firing position; approaching central enemy damage after artillery clearance.

damage_partition.artillery: Steward alone owns flying-artillery damage. Midnight cannot attack the flying route in this executor.
damage_partition.central: Midnight supplies available sustained damage. Steward damages approaching enemies inside rows 3-4, columns 6-8 after artillery priority releases him; he does not cover either holder's tile.
damage_partition.outer: Midnight holds the upper route. Melantha's normal officer damage is 588 per hit before skills; one-block clearance must finish before the next arrival.

economy.conditions: Every credited grant requires Fang alive and deployed. No kill DP or unsupported talent income is credited.
economy.refund_rule: Current executor refunds floor(paid cost/2) on living withdrawal; death refunds zero. These are model costs, not asserted client redeployment costs.

medical_partition.geometry: Read-only range calculations confirmed every recipient. Hibiscus-centered splash excludes both lower holders; Steward-centered splash excludes Ansel.
medical_partition.limitation: Delivered healing, competing HP ratios and incidental splash remain survival dependencies.

formation_structure.opening: Fang and Friston intercept centrally. Midnight supplies opening damage. Melantha enters before the lower outer runner; Hibiscus then restores lower HP before sustained artillery exposure.
formation_structure.validation: Read-only legality, range, conditional DP and manual-SP calculations passed. No simulation or file mutation was performed.

formation_transitions.transition: Melantha establishes lower-outer blocking before the first runner reaches column 5.
Hibiscus begins lower recovery; preserve Friston before his next officer engagement.
Ansel establishes ordinary healing of the entire upper group, including Steward's future tile.
Midnight converts to arts for upper restraint clearance and available hostile damage.
Steward enters the eastern firing position before the artillery's lower eastern wait.
Midnight's second arts window supports central armor and outer officers; self-blocked priority remains binding.
Hostile-clearance checkpoint: withdraw living Steward only after his damage duty and residual-projectile risk have ended.
Withdraw living Melantha only after the lower outer route is empty.
Return Steward west after 2101 frames; clear upper western restraint.
Return Melantha west after her own 2101-frame gap; clear lower western restraint.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Keep Fang and Friston alive through the opening runners and officers; establish all four lane interceptions and lower healing.
Clear eastern restraints, establish Steward, and deliver recipient-specific healing through the first artillery acquisition cycle.
Sustain Steward through repeated artillery hits, clear paired outer officers, and destroy artillery before its western attack cycle.
Convert Steward's released firing time into approach damage; clear central armor and preserve slots for paired runners.
Finish final armor and remaining blocked enemies. Keep all blocking and medical duties until hostile clearance is observed.
Execute legal western rotations, destroy both remaining restraints and observe two distinct safe protected-target arrivals.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP only while alive and deployed.
Ordinary blocking and attacks; no unsupported robot talent.
First arts window advances upper restraint clearance; later windows clear central armor and surviving ground enemies. No flying-artillery damage is credited.
Cover paired lower officers, late outer pressure and cleanup. Initial restraint clearance uses ordinary attacks.
Boost lower healing across artillery and lane pressure; 20-second duration followed by at least 30 inactive seconds.
Boost upper healing through Steward's artillery exposure and later central pressure; 25-second duration followed by at least 35 inactive seconds. No extra-heal talent is credited.
Supported high-defense priority and automatic enhanced attacks; no manual activation.

user_confirmed_tactical_premise: Enemy attacks have intervals; many attacks point at one object and occupy the attacker during the action. Operators may bait attacks, absorb key hits, buy replacement/output windows, and may deliberately withdraw or sacrifice for these effects. This is USER_CONFIRMED_TACTICAL_PREMISE, not new client evidence. Do not generalize it to all attacks, phases, targets, cooldowns, retreats, landing tiles, or cycles; every tactic must identify the known or assumed behavior it uses.
